items.title: 830: “GTA VI” Sales Soar as Anthropic Shares Tumble Post-IPO
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts Julie Hyman, Jake Conley, and Pras Subramanian tackle the top stories of the day, including stocks selling off as AI buckles, Anthropic (ANT) shares tumbling post-IPO, and Take-Two Interactive Software's (TTWO)  “GTA VI” sales surging to $2 billion.

items.title: 'GTA VI' blows past $2B in sales since launch: Inside one of 2026's biggest cultural moments
items.summary:
Sales of Take-Two Interactive's (TTWO) "Grand Theft Auto VI" have reportedly exceeded $2 billion since coming out on Thursday, according to data from Sensor Tower.

The 8:30 Hosts Pras Subramanian, Julie Hyman, and Jake Conley discuss the cultural phenomenon surrounding the long-awaited video game and what sets it apart from previous installments in the franchise.
